steps.title: An open C shape
steps.body:
C is the short written name for C major: C, E and G. Use fret 3 on string 5, fret 2 on string 4, open string 3, fret 1 on string 2, and open string 1. Leave string 6 out.

**Why it matters:** This full shape repeats C and E in higher octaves but keeps the same three names as your first chord.

steps.title: Read and hear the notes
steps.body: Start from string 5. The two C sounds and two E sounds repeat notes; the G is open string 3. Take your time with the reach between frets 1 and 3.

items.prompt: Play C, E, G, C, E together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Clear your selection before changing between Am and C. Notice that strings 2 and 1 stay in the same positions. Finger choices come in the later hand-training lessons.
